items.title: Microsoft Edge is about to lock out older ad blockers, just like Chrome did
items.blurb: Microsoft Edge is ending support for Manifest V2 extensions like uBlock Origin starting this month.

items.title: Kitesurf: Agent-first browser that runs in V8 isolates
items.blurb: We should be giving all agents tools that excel at what’s important for an AI model.

items.title: Uno Platform 6.6 Adds Native AOT, Vulkan Rendering, and Broader Accessibility Support
items.blurb: Uno Platform 6.6 introduces Native AOT publishing across five target platforms, an optional Vulkan rendering backend, and automatic registration for the framework’s Model Context Protocol servers.

items.title: IP and DNS Leaks in WebKit Affecting Proxy Browsers and iCloud Private Relay
items.blurb: WebKit-based browsers on iOS and macOS can be configured to route all web traffic through proxy servers, which is how Tor browsers on iOS and our own Psylo work.

items.title: Results from the 2026 State of CSS Survey
Josh Comeau wrote an excellent primer on anchor positioning
items.blurb: For decades, one of the most notoriously-challenging problems on the web has been sticking one element to another element, for things like tooltips and nested menus.

items.title: Get Screenshots of Your Frontend in Each PR
items.blurb: Greptile TREX runs your PR branch in a sandbox to catch the bugs that only show up at runtime, then leaves the logs, screenshots, and traces on the PR.

items.title: Styling the Navigation: Declarative Route and Navigation Matching in CSS
items.blurb: One of the things that we at Chrome have been thinking about for a while now is a way to do declarative route and navigation matching in CSS.

items.title: MDN shares its pageview data
items.blurb: TIL: MDN exposes up-to-date page view data through https://popularities.mdn.mozilla.net/current.csv. Using Google AI Studio, I generated a visualizer to explore the data.

items.title: Gap Decorations Are Now Available, Here's What's New
items.blurb: Today, with CSS gap decorations fully supported in Chrome and Edge, starting with version 149, you can now very easily style gaps, and with a lot of control.
